item.title: 🟠 Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a high-severity security flaw impacting UnrealIRCd, an open-source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. item.title: 🔴 Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups, endpoint protection, and recovery readiness.
An international police operation took down servers behind Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC this week. Criminals used the three malware tools to gain access to computers, steal passwords, and launch ransomware attacks.
